Defense overlay shows tower defenses, along activity (that's a secret code for SHOOTING) and reload
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473995/64293599037298e8d456aeaaaea6c3d9db7ac6e8.png[/img]
Power overlay showing power flow and relative production/usage of buildings[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473995/95cc25f1301f1f3c8218cf177a6540d04474eed8.png[/img]
Resource collecting buildings now show connection lines when placing
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473995/3778585cdc693bea84e123c987f84776a75b5127.png[/img]
